batting.dismissal: c PJ Sangwan b R Bhatia

balls.text: run out, full on middle and leg, driven down the ground to long-on, they go for the second and Karthik takes down the stumps, collecting an accurate throw to finish the innings
slower one outside off, kept really low, zipped under the bat as he went for a slog
much quicker, full and wide, makes room, strikes it well but slices it straight to Sangwan at deep point waiting exactly for that
on middle and leg, tried to push it down the leg side, squeezes a leg bye
slower legcutter outside off, went for the cut, missed
slower one bowled at 94.8 kmph, was into the pull too early, tried to dispatch it past midwicket, missed and the stumps take a beating
short of a good length outside off, goes for the pull, gets a thick edge wide of point for a single
i'll do it myself he says, and follows that up with some more abuse, yorker on the off stump and Harbhajan is late in bringing down his bat, the stumps are clattered and the bowler can breathe easy

thick edge and spilled again by Karthik as he dives to his right, wouldn't have mattered but Nehra makes it a point to hurl a series of abuses at Karthik, reminds me of his outburst against Dhoni when he had dropped Afridi once
Delhi have let their guard down here, oversteps and hurls it wide, freehit time

dropped, Karthik drops a dolly, slipped through his gloves, skied at while looking for a swipe over long-on, took ages to come down but the keeper didn't have to move much, looked good to pouch it but faltered at just the last moment
slower one on middle and leg, dropped short of the bowler and sets off for a single
poor ball, low full toss outside off, makes room and steers that behind point to beat third man, important runs these
takes his team past 100 with a trademark swat over long-off, short on the off stump, made room and slapped it with a flat bat into the stands
missed run out, slapped towards midwicket who's a little too deep, Gambhir rockets a throw at the non-striker's end, misses and Rahane was gone had that hit
excellent shot, but just for a single, short on the off, walks across and pulls it away on the bounce to deep midwicket
length on middle and off, chips it towards long-off for a single
fortunate, and they'll take it, short on the off, went for a mighty pull, got a thick edge over the keeper's head to the third-man boundary
back of a length on middle, makes room and slaps it over the bowler's head, not well enough though, just a single wide of mid-on
stepped out of the crease, made room to cream that through the off side, missed
short and wide, too close to cut but chases it, zips past the outside edge, 120 seems far off now
short of a good length on middle, dropped short of cover, calls for a single but is sent back
good length on middle and off, defended solidly back to the bowler
back of a length on middle, fended it away on the leg side and stole a quick single

short ball bowled quick on middle, went for the pull, was a little too quick for him, got the top edge and AB de Villiers at midwicket ran in a a few yards, dived forward and snapped it cleanly to complete a good catch
it yields a wicket, angling away from Bravo, a length ball, has a wild swing at it, gets a thick edge and Karthik takes it well diving to his right
had him reaching for it, tried to steer it past point, missed, called a wide, a little harsh. How costly will that prove?
good acceleration here, slightly short on the off, pulled away over midwicket, didn't time it as well as he would have liked but had enough on it to take it to the ropes
bouncer banged in on middle, went for the hook but was a touch too high
brings up the fifty partnership, got under it nicely, length ball again, made room and produced a good clean hit over long-on, nice sound of bat hitting ball
good length on the off, plays a Dhoniesque hoick towards long-on
fullish on the off, drags it over midwickket, bends low and slogs it away, much-needed four, length ball, needs to hold it back
good length outside off, makes room and taps it behind point for a single
bowled it quick on leg stump, had a massive swipe at it, in vain, the ball dropped on the pitch, opportunity missed
oversteps, freehit time, swatted down to deep midwicket
on middle and off, defended to cover from the crease
that's dismissed, flighted outside off, was tempted, stepped out and smashed it flat over the deep extra-cover boundary, the first six of the innings
tossed up outside off, steps out of the crease, chasing the line of the ball, driving it to deep midwicket
tossed up on middle and leg, worked wide of midwicket for a single
overpitched on the off, driven through the line to long-off
mistimes a pull, was into it a little too early, hit the bottom-end of the bat and landed safely, just wide of midwicket for a single
swinging in, chases him as he makes room, pitches it full, bunts it down to long-off
good length on the off, defended on the pitch, calls for a single but is sent back wisely
swinging in, gets across and pushes it wide of mid-off for a single
struck neatly, length ball on the off, driven firmly down the ground to long-off
another slower ball, but Bravo picks it and gets across his stumps, working it with the wrists for a single wide of Gambhir this time
gets across and clips a fullish ball straight to Gambhir at midwicket
on middle and leg and worked down toward mid-on for one
smart change-up delivery, much straighter and on a length and it beats the bat and the wicketkeeper, running down toward short fine leg
some needed oomph now from Bravo, using the extra width to drive the ball on the rise over extra cover for four, splitting two fielders in the deep
slower ball, pitched right up, and Bravo pushes into the off side
short of a good length on middle, whipped away to deep square leg
pushed off the back foot to cover
almost five down, bouncer on middle, went for the hook, was late on the shot, got a top edge and Karthik put in a valiant dive running back but couldn't quite hold on
on middle and leg, gets across and tries to force it past midwicket, is struck on the pads, may have just been sliding down, or maybe not, was hit in line but probably just a little high
back of a length on the off, pushed back to the bowler from the crease
good length on the off and moving away just a hint, tries to open the face to guide it down, misses
short on the off, makes room and slaps it to deep cover
quicker one bowled on the off, comes down and punches it straight to midwicket
the googly, handled well, worked it away off the back foot wide of square leg for a single
spun back in from a good length outside off, punched to deep cover
on middle and leg, pushed towards midwicket, calls for a single, is sent back, rightly
short of a good length outside off, guided straight to point
slower one bowled short of a length outside off, guided down to third man and gets a much needed break
slower one, a legcutter, covers it nicely and defends it back to the bowler
slower one bowled on a length on middle and off, flicked away wide of midwicket
shortish outside off, dabbed down to point
back of a length outside off, eased off the back foot to deep cover
slower one on leg stump, pushed towards deep midwicket for a single
tossed up on the off, spun away, got forward and dropped it towards point
landed short on middle and leg, slapped away wide of midwicket for a single
short and wide, reaches for a cut, misses
short of a good length on the off, punched down to long-off
pushed away to cover, away from his body
did it strike him in line? Went on straight, was struck on the pads, bowled flat and leg stump and hit in line while playing for the spin, is lucky
on middle and leg, pushed with a straight bat to long-on for a single
straying down the leg side, went through, given a wide

Pinal's gone, and like the last game against Deccan, he's thrown it away, full on middle and leg, made room and struck it straight to long-on, poor shot under the circumstances and whoever it was rooting for him, sorry bud
stump-to-stump, defended towards midwicket on the front foot
slower one bowled short on middle, pushed back past the bowler for a single
back of a length on the off, turned away to midwicket and calls for a single, would have been out had that hit, Pinal was sent back and was struggling to reach on his way back
tossed up, full on the off, dropped short of cover for a quick single
short of a length on the off, punched to cover from the crease
went on straight, short on middle, punched back to the bowler
spinning into middle from outside off, dropped into the leg side
tossed up on middle, steps to the pitch and drives it down the ground for a single
pushed off the front foot to midwicket

run out, short of a good length on middle, dropped it on the pitch, but it bounced just wide of the stumps, sets off for a single, is sent back and the keeper throws down the stumps, and there's an appeal. Replays indicate Tendulkar was just short while trying to make it back. Karthik's done well, but that was an impossible run. Tendulkar probably didn't see where the ball went, and had run too far before changing his mind. Massive blow.
on middle and off, dropped short of Dilshan at cover and sets off for a quick single
back of a length, a touch too high for a short-statured Pinal who tries to help that over the keeper's head
nicely timed, got forward to the pitch and creamed it just wide of cover where AB dived to save a couple of runs
back of a length on middle, turned to square leg off the back foot
Pinal goes after it, not to the pitch, the rule doesn't apply to him, swings it blindly over square leg for a couple
boundary, bringing it back in, but a touch too full on middle, flicked away beautifully between midwicket and square leg for four more
short of a good length outside of, pushed away to cover, fails to beat the gap
back of a length on middle, pushed back to the bowler from deep in the crease
nipped back in, rapped high on the pads as he tried to whip it past midwicket,, stifled appeal for caught-behind
punished, short and wide, makes room and slashes it hard wide of point for a boundary, Sangwan's shown scratching his head

dropped by Sangwan, he's taking tips from the Kolkata fielders here, skied it to mid-on, a hapless shot, vain attempt to clear the in-field and mistimed it, Sangwan reached to his right and spilled it, fearing a possible collision with Gambhir at mid-off
slower one bowled short on middle, punched off the back foot to mid-off
meaty length ball on the pads, flicked away to fine leg, one more
back of a length on the off, swatted over square leg, wide of fine leg for a couple
He's following Nehra's lead here, down the leg side, called a wide
Pinal's playing like himself, slightly short, went for a pull, missed
on middle and leg, clipped away to fine leg for a single
short of a good length on the off, pushed to cover
good length on middle and off, jabbed towards mid-off, awkward defense but that's his style
short outside off, Pinal trying to be too clever there, tried to upper-cut that past the keeper, was a little late on the shot
nippy, hit the pitch hard, leapt at him and he responded, defending it off the back foot short of the bowler
good length on the off, defended off the front foot in the direction of cover
testing him with a length ball on the off, defended wide of midwicket
a touch too straight, eased wide of midwicket for a quick single
found the gap, too close to cut, got back and just punched it wide of a diving cover for a couple
short of a good length on middle, whipped to midwicket, screams 'wait' as Pinal thinks of a single
nicely done, a touch too straight on middle, flicked away between mid-on and midwicket for a couple
another wide, Nehra off to a false start here, leaves it be and earns a run
not anymore, banged in short on middle, turned away off the back foot wide of midwicket for a single
back of a length outside off, angling away further, left alone, another wide, Mumbai's only source of runs so far
good length outside off and moving back in, drove at it from the crease, missed it as he was almost done in by the spin
back of a length on middle, rocks back and drops it on the pitch
full and wide, angling away even further, left alone, given a wide
Mumbai in trouble, probing him outside off, just a hint of away movement, fishes for it away from his body, gets a thin edge straight to the keeper
bouncer, banged in short just outside off, Duminy backs away from it
beaten, nipped back in from a good length outside off, got back to defend but ended up playing inside the line
on middle and off, pushed away to midwicket off the back foot

run out, Ronchi's gone, dabbed it short of cover and set off, Warner collected it cleanly and threw down the stumps at the non-striker's end to find the opener miles short, Jayasuriya's replacement goes for a duck
sliding down leg, tries to clip it fine, misses but gets a wide
swinging into the right hander, lands on a good length on middle, defended to cover
all over, full toss on middle, pushed away between square leg and midwicket for a boundary to seal a seven-wicket win
yorker length on middle and leg, dug it out awkwardly, got a thick inside edge wide of square leg for a single, reaches his fifty, well done
full toss on the off, opens the face to guide it to third man
length ball on middle, bunted down the ground to long-on
full toss outside off, steered from the crease wide of point to beat third man, nicely timed
yorker on middle and leg, did well to keep it out, played it wide of midwicket
edged and gone, overpitched outside off, made room to guide that past the keeper, got a thick edge and Pinal took it easily
full and wide, makes room and slices it in the direction of deep cover
on middle, fired in at 137 kmph, pushes it wide of midwicket for a couple
fullish on leg stump, driven straight to midwicket
good length on middle and leg, defended to midwicket
that's dismissed, enjoyed a momentary high with those three dot balls and now will go back disappointed, full and wide, creamed wide of point with a flourish, raced away to the ropes
fullish on the off, made room to clear cover there, got a thick edge past the keeper to beat third man for a boundary
slower ball bowled short outside off, waited for it and chopped it behind point, well wide of Harbhajan at third man to scramble back for three runs, brings up the 50-stand
straying on the pads, misses out as he tries to glance it fine, is hit on the pads, three dot balls
fullish on the off, on target, dug out towards point
short of a length on the off, pushed off the back foot to cover
flighted on middle, driven past the bowler down to long-on for a single, 19 off the over, failed gamble
absolutely terrible, Mumbai have squandered a good few overs here, short on the off, enough time for de Villiers to rock back and bludgeon that wide of deep midwicket
long hop again, was lucky it kept low, got an underedge wide of the keeper
poor, short, rank long hop on middle, the offspinner again, pulled away into the same gap for a boundary, the Mumbai captain has thrown it away
that'll do it even more, poor ball, full toss on middle, smashed away over the deep-midwicket boundary, the decisive bowling change
superb shot, tossed up outside off, gets to the pitch and flicks it away between long-on and deep midwicket for a boundary, that'll relieve the pressure a little
misses out, bowled short on middle, pulled away straight to deep square leg
short of a length outside off, makes room and slashes it down to deep point
fullish on middle, down the track and bunts it to long-on
struck him outside the line, spun in to rap him on the pads as he tried to work that away
short and wide, held its line, cut away to deep point
flighted on the off, comes down the track and drives it down to long-on
covers the spin by closing the face and pushing it to long-on
nicely done, slightly quick through the air, waited for it and guided it just at the last moment behind point to beat a diving Bravo to the boundary
drops it on the back foot wide of leg slip for a quick single, they need to push now
pushes him back, spun in, punched down to long-on for a single
quicker one bowled short on the off, defended back to the bowler
quicker one bowled flat outside off, rapped on the pads as he tried to sweep, was struck outside the line
flighted on middle, comes down, reaches and pushes it to midwicket, another dot ball, the pressure builds
flighted on middle, comes down the track to work it away, gets the leading edge wide of cover, an accurate throw at the keeper's end would have had him
makes room and mistimes a cut back to the bowler, dot ball again
tossed up outside off, makes room and cuts it straight to point
comes down the track and drives it down the ground to long-on
flighted it and he was tempted, took it on the full and sliced it just short of deep point for a single
bowled on a good length outside off, walked across and dropped it towards square leg
spun in sharply from middle, did well to keep it down, tickled it wide of leg slip for a single
fullish on middle and leg, sweeps it down to fine leg
spun in, struck him just outside the line as he tried to play it into the leg side
straying on the pads, swept down to fine leg for a single
short on the off, moves across and bunts it down to deep midwicket
tossed up, tried to caress it through the off side, mistimed it back to the bowler
low full toss on the off, driven down the ground to long-on
short of a length outside off, tries to work it away behind square, brushes the thighs on the way to leg slip
flighted outside off, gets to the pitch and drives it to cover
short and wide, went for the cut, too wide though and even the keeper missed it, they get two runs in all
short on the off, pushed away wide of midwicket for a single
tossed up on the off, gets forward and defends it back to the bowler
excelent fielding by Duminy at short fine, made room to cut, got an under edge past the keeper but a diving leg slip at least saved a couple
on middle and off, spun in, tried to dab it into the off side, got a thickish inside edge towards midwicket
the straighter one, got across the line to play it into the leg side, played inside the line and got a leading edge wide of point
risky shot, fetched it from outside off, went way across and swept it wide of leg slip for a boundary, was uppish and had Harbhajan interested just for a moment
on middle and leg, flicked away over square leg for a single

Gambhir falls, this gets a little interesting now, tossed up outside off, came down the track and drove it uppishly, did so well but found the fielder stationed perfectly for that at deep cover, Ronchi ran a few steps to his left and took it well
short of a length outside off, makes room and cuts it away towards deep point for a single
spun back in again, dropped short of point and rushes off again, Gambhir is the one stretching this time and makes it in quite comfortably in the end
short on middle and off, dropped short of point and Dilshan responds to call for a quick single, dives in and makes it easily
flighted on the off, reaches forward to defend, gets an inside edge onto his pads and gets a single
stumped, tossed up and Warner's eyes lit up, stepped out of the crease to dismiss that over long-on, the ball spun away to beat the swing of the bat and Pinal dislodged the bails to find him short
short of a good length on the off, punched back to the bowler
bowled outside leg, tries to work it away, does so but didn't seem to know where it went, Gambhir rushes down and he responds, had turned it behind square
quicker one bowled short on the off, dropped short of point and rushes off for a single
short of a length outside off, makes room to cut, chops it down towards point
much slower through the air, landed outside leg and spun in, jabbed it wide of midwicket for a single
quicker one bowled full on the off, driven back to the bowler
tossed up, gets to the pitch and chips it wide of cover for a single
a touch too wide, has enough room to drive it down the ground to long-off
on middle and off, gets forward and opens the face at the last moment to guide it to short third
short on the off, cut away straight to point, failing to find the gaps here but there's plenty of time left
short of a good length outside off, chopped down to point from the crease
short, just outside off, tries to be a little cheeky, looks to late-cut it wide of third man, misses
good length outside off, tries to push through the line, gets a thick edge down to third man
dropped it short, slapped it past the bowler on the bounce to mid-off for a quick single
went after it, length ball outside off, slapped it straight back to the bowler, didn't time it well enough
good length on the off, moves back and punches it to cover, straight to the fielder
short of a good length outside off, dabbed down to third man for a single
back of a length on the off, crunched wide of mid-off for a quick single
saw him come down and dropped it wide, Warner didn't reach for it, left it be
hurled at 137.8 kmph on middle, chipped wide of midwicket for a single
walked down and tried to force it through the off side, pushed it wide of point but wsn't able to beat the gap, gets a single nevertheless
banged in short, pays the price, rocks back and pulls it away comfortably over square leg for a boundary
slower one bowled short outside off, punched to cover off the back foot
bouncer down the leg side, given a wide, Delhi are taking their time here
straying on the pads, tickled down to fine leg for a single
slower one bowled full on the off, drilled to mid-off for a quick single
pushed off the back foot towards cover who's  slightly deep in the circle, gives them enough time to sneak a single
slower one bowled short on the off, clatters it straight to cover, too many slower ones we've seen today
there's cover, walked down the pitch, took it on the half-volley and drove it well but straight to deep cover
quick single, hangs his bat out and pushes it wide of cover
back of a length on middle, chopped down to cover off the back foot
short of a good length on the off, crunched to cover off the front foot
targeting leg stump, turned away to fine leg where Ronchi gets into the act, probably his only act in the game, returning the ball from fine leg
slower one banged in short on middle, went for the pull, too early into the shot, five slower ones in a row
slow full toss outside off, mistimes an attempted offdrive to midwicket
ovrpitched on middle and off, looks to clear mid-off but the bat turns in his hand, ends up slicing it over the covers for a couple more
slower one bowled short on middle, rolls his wrists over it and plays it to square leg, didn't pick that one but adjusted well
slower one on leg stump, bowled at 117.4 kmph, got under it nicely, picked the pace early and carted it over long-on for a six, Delhi are away
fullish, overpitched outside off, presents the full face to drive it straight to mid-off
gave him the charge and creamed it straight to cover, length ball that he failed to dispatch
short of a good length on middle, punched wide of midwicket for a single
dropped on the off side short of point for a single
back of a length outside off, punched wide of mid-off for a single
short of a good length outside off, moves across and dabs it to mid-off
half-volley outside off stump and Gambhir doesn't disappoint, square-driving into the window between cover and point for the first four of the innings
short this time and still wide of the pads so another freebie
sprayed down the pads, slower ball, and Shah fumbles the collection
aiming at middle and off, Warner gets back and pushes to cover
good stuff this, right up there on the stumps and Warner does well to make a bit of room and bunts the ball down past Gambhir, mid-off does well to get across
again wrong line, full and on the toes and clipped to deep fine leg
just a tad straighter on middle and leg and he checks his attempted flick
as so often happens when opening bowlers are first bowling to Gambhir, Malinga pitches on the pads and is lucky the flick it cut off by midwicket
